Oneline information was conflicting, so these are the measurements I made of mine:

Dropout dimensions:

- Front: 100 mm width, 15 mm diameter thru axle
- Rear: 142 mm width, 12 mm diameter thru axle

Build details

- Rear hub is a SRAM XD drive train.
- Both are ISO 6-bolt brake rotor mounts
